source: Constructed by the model as a candidate counterexample, in the genre of a classroom moral case. Not drawn from a documented dispute. Recorded with its reduction.

residue_candidates.claim: an irreducible clash between counting outcomes and refusing to use a person
residue_candidates.note: The divergence is entirely in optionality assignment: one side holds the one and the several fixed and generates options only for the decider; the other treats all three as option-generating. Same weighting, different assignment.

residue_candidates.claim: both sides accept the presented option set as complete
residue_candidates.note: Not residue between the sides — it is agreement between them, and it is the thing neither audits. Routes to presented-binary. Recorded here because agreement across both sides is where a shared unmeasured assumption sits.
